name: fujibee/agmsg — Claude Code + Codex + Gemini + Copilot Message Each Other via SQLite, No Daemon
hook: Cross-vendor messaging for CLI AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Copilot CLI write and read a shared local SQLite file — no daemon, no server, no Node or Python required.
